about_the_game:
You are BRU. All you wanted was some milk for your coffee, but ended up incarcerated for a crime you did in fact commit. The indomitable human spirit cannot be denied however, as Bru must now stage an escape from prison to get some sugar for his caffeine fix.

But all of Earth's sugar is mysteriously disappearing, and as you point and click yourself deeper into the seedy under, mid, and top belly of Kifftown, Bru will uncover a conspiracy that goes even deeper than his underpants.

Bru and Boegie : Episode 2 – Get Da Sugar is another colorful, fully animated and fully-voiced adventure, that will test the limits of your Big Brain.

Fortune favours the bald, and now’s your time to shine (your head).

Features:

  • WE ARE IN CONTROL: Incredibly intuitive one-button-gameplay.

  • THEY’RE ALL LAUGHING AT YOU: Bru's particular brand of irreverent and satirical humor has been perfectly tuned to appeal to your brain. That’s right, YOU.

  • THEY’RE EVERYWHERE: Explore deeper into Kifftown, and discover more of its weirdo inhabitants.

  • TIME IS AN ILLUSION: Roughly double the length of the first game, this episode will inch you closer to your end.

  • A GAME WITHIN A GAME: Play a host of mini-games to consume you from the inside.

  • THEY’RE HIDING IN PLAIN SIGHT: A host of secret collectables to find and keep you up at night.

  • THE VOICES, THEY’RE GETTING LOUDER!: Fully voiced by actual humans…or are they???

All this and more await you in Bru & Boegie: Episode 2 - Get da SUGAR!

Whispers on the wind speak of Episode 3 coming soon.

Possibly. Maybe. Allegedly.
